tokens.usage: Page ground. Every text pairing below is checked against it.

tokens.name: color-pixel-red
tokens.usage: Alerts, primary actions (5.1:1 contrast). Used as text on `.required-indicator`, `.form-error`. 3.4:1 on `page-bg` — large text (24px+) or non-text marks only.

tokens.name: color-pixel-blue
tokens.usage: Links, info states (4.7:1 contrast). Used as background on `.card-header`; text on `.btn-secondary`. 2.8:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: color-pixel-green

tokens.name: color-pixel-yellow
tokens.usage: Warnings, highlights (3.8:1 on white). tokens.name: color-pixel-purple

tokens.name: color-screen-black

tokens.name: color-screen-white
